thaumictinkerer.recipe_viewers.necromanc: Put the three soul aspects, in any order, on Arcane Pedestals at most 5 blocks from the tablet, at its height.
Every 300 ticks (15 seconds) the tablet summons the mob on top of itself and uses the soul aspects up.
Three infused soul aspects are kept, but work only every 1200 ticks (one minute); another tablet first only takes them over, summoning nothing.
A redstone signal stops the tablet.
thaumictinkerer.recipe_viewers.seed_drop: A ripe crop yields one of:
Each harvest of a ripe crop draws one of these, with the chance shown on it.
An Ordo tendency of n draws once more with a chance of n in 75, again and again.
The crop also drops its seeds; an unripe crop drops only the seeds.
